headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang; CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for $44B; EU proposes new Russia sanctions

austin.headline: UT team wins CDC grant to forecast flu as season starts early
austin.summary: UT Austin's Center for Pandemic Decision Science will launch a CDC-funded flu forecasting effort as Texas sees one of the nation's highest rates of flu-like illness visits.

texas.headline: Texas Supreme Court dismisses long-running SB 8 challenge
texas.summary: The court threw out 14 consolidated suits by abortion-rights groups against Texas Right to Life, leaving intact the law that lets private citizens sue abortion providers.

texas.headline: First state study of college DEI ban is inconclusive
texas.summary: A Coordinating Board report found grades and retention steady or better but enrollment rates of admitted Black and Hispanic students down, and said it can't tell whether the ban caused either trend.

texas.headline: Democrats line up voucher repeal and universal pre-K
texas.summary: With control of the House and statewide offices but not the Senate, Democrats plan bills to repeal the roughly $1 billion voucher program, rework school takeovers and fund pre-K for all 4-year-olds.

texas.headline: Cypress replanting begins on flood-scarred Guadalupe
texas.summary: San Antonio Botanical Garden and partners aim to plant 50,000 bald cypress along the river in Kerr County over two years, backed by a $2 million matching grant.

us.headline: Incoming Democratic senators weigh Schumer vs. Van Hollen
us.summary: Thirteen newly elected Democrats will help decide a Dec. 1 secret-ballot vote for Senate Democratic leader, with progressive groups backing challenger Chris Van Hollen.

us.headline: Trump halts Iowa chemical detonation pending court and governor-elect
us.summary: The Army won't blow up 68 barrels of degraded lead azide near Middletown unless the 8th Circuit approves and Gov.-elect Rob Sand agrees, after environmental groups won a stay.

us.headline: California Rep. Gomez resigns after ethics report
us.summary: The California Democrat stepped down following an ethics report on sexual misconduct allegations against him.

australia.headline: Coalition turns against Vanuatu security pact
australia.summary: The opposition won't back the $500 million Nakamal Agreement over its net zero clause, though the government can ratify it without parliament.

australia.headline: Fast-tracked defence laws draw overreach criticism
australia.summary: New laws let the defence minister declare security zones with jail terms of up to seven years for trespass, and critics including David Pocock and the Greens say the powers are too broad.

australia.headline: Digital duty of care bill set to pass with Greens support
australia.summary: The online safety bill is headed through the Senate after the Greens backed it and the Coalition said it would vote against.

australia.headline: Solomon Islands reported poised to end China security deal
australia.summary: Honiara is moving to end its contentious security agreement with Beijing, ABC's parliament coverage reports, as Penny Wong warned US-China rivalry is eroding global rules.

australia.headline: Carroll pitches Victorian election as a health referendum
australia.summary: With polling day on Nov. 28, the premier framed the vote around healthcare while One Nation ruled out a coalition with the Liberals or Nationals.

ai.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
ai.summary: Nvidia's board brought Huang back days after ruling out his return, and President Trump claimed credit for the reversal.

ai.headline: GOP lawmakers object to White House role in Huang's return
ai.summary: Republican senators criticised the administration's involvement in the Nvidia board decision and raised national security questions.

ai.headline: Amazon to buy Decart's AI chip software and hire founders
ai.summary: Amazon agreed to acquire the AI startup's chip software and bring on its founding team.

ai.headline: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok deepfakes
ai.summary: The two states filed suits over AI-generated sexual deepfakes and safety claims tied to the Grok chatbot.

tech.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for $44 billion
tech.summary: The cybersecurity deal comes as AI tools drive a rise in cyberattacks.

tech.headline: Jay Clayton named interim national cyber director
tech.summary: The director of national intelligence will also serve as acting national cyber director.

tech.headline: Mexico demands SpaceX clean up suspected Starship debris
tech.summary: More than 1,500 fragments believed to be from the Nov. 13 booster explosion have washed up near Matamoros, and authorities told the public not to touch them.

world.headline: EU proposes 22nd Russia sanctions package
world.summary: The plan would cut 60 more Russian banks from SWIFT, target over 70 shadow fleet vessels and bar Russian-flagged athletes from EU sports events, with a deal sought in December.

world.headline: Zelenskyy cites 2,700 Russian drones in a week
world.summary: Ukraine's president said Russia also fired about 165 missiles in the past week, and three Russian cruise missiles were reported to have entered Polish airspace.

world.headline: Drought deepens Afghanistan's humanitarian crisis
world.summary: Severe drought is pushing millions of Afghans further into hardship, PBS NewsHour reports.

world.headline: US to co-host 2031 Women's World Cup
world.summary: The United States will stage the tournament with Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica, the AP reports.

aus-cricket.headline: Labuschagne out in freak fashion as Queensland lead NSW
aus-cricket.summary: Labuschagne fell for 34 when the ball bounced off his chest onto his bat, and rain-hit day three at the SCG ended with Queensland 2-106, 81 ahead.

aus-cricket.headline: Smith makes 12 in Shield return from neck injury
aus-cricket.summary: Steve Smith was trapped lbw by Michael Neser in his first innings since October, ahead of the first Test against New Zealand in Perth on Dec. 9.

aus-cricket.headline: Debutant Shaw eyes his chance as T20I series moves to Gold Coast
aus-cricket.summary: NSW keeper-batter Lachy Shaw debuted in Australia's three-wicket MCG win over England, with the second match on the Gold Coast today.

warriors.headline: Warriors host winless-in-group Kings in NBA Cup Wednesday
warriors.summary: Golden State (9-8, 1-1 in West Group C) puts a seven-game home win streak on the line against Sacramento (2-14) on Nov. 25.

warriors.headline: Brandon Williams on track to return against Sacramento
warriors.summary: Kerr said Williams (hamstring) should play Wednesday, while Curry, Porzingis, Moody and Butler remain out.
